title: Kai explains Achievements

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Hello. Why did you take so long? Tik tok. Time is money for a hacker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello. Why did you take so long? Tik tok. Time is money for a hacker.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: I was expecting you. Ava has been programmed to lead you to me. This was part of Thaddeus Carminus' plan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was expecting you. Ava has been programmed to lead you to me. This was part of Thaddeus Carminus' plan.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: You want to learn how to move more freely around the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want to learn how to move more freely around the city.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: I will assist you. But you will be required to do some work too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will assist you. But you will be required to do some work too.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: You know I'm a hacker, yes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know I'm a hacker, yes?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Well, Thaddeus arranged some exciting travel privileges for you here in Nivalis. Potentially.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, Thaddeus arranged some exciting travel privileges for you here in Nivalis. Potentially.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: The word "why" doesn't really fit Thaddeus. Asking "why" Thaddeus did something is like asking "What did the people who made the ground stand on?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The word "why" doesn't really fit Thaddeus. Asking "why" Thaddeus did something is like asking "What did the people who made the ground stand on?"

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Thaddeus asked me to hack a tourist visa for you. I've already updated your public access records with CorpSec.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thaddeus asked me to hack a tourist visa for you. I've already updated your public access records with CorpSec.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: It's a good thing. Hacked tourist visas go for thousands of Lims on the black market. For a fully unlocked one, millions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a good thing. Hacked tourist visas go for thousands of Lims on the black market. For a fully unlocked one, millions.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Just remember, you're a tourist now. You're going to have to act like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just remember, you're a tourist now. You're going to have to act like it.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: These visas were part of a scheme by the now-defunct Nivalis tourism board to get settlers born in the Ventz to visit the city. The idea was tourists would bring in lots of money. Problem is, the folks that live in the Ventz don't use money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: These visas were part of a scheme by the now-defunct Nivalis tourism board to get settlers born in the Ventz to visit the city. The idea was tourists would bring in lots of money. Problem is, the folks that live in the Ventz don't use money.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: I don't know. Some sort of mold. Point is, these tourist visas were a great way for anyone who could get their hands on one to move around the city freely without buying a whole stack of local access cards.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Some sort of mold. Point is, these tourist visas were a great way for anyone who could get their hands on one to move around the city freely without buying a whole stack of local access cards.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So with this tourist visa I can go anywhere?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So with this tourist visa I can go anywhere?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So with this tourist visa I can go anywhere?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So with this tourist visa I can go anywhere?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: No, not exactly. Or not straight away.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, not exactly. Or not straight away.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: For now, Ava should point you in the right direction. Follow her instructions. She's an advanced Automata and her advice should be heeded.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For now, Ava should point you in the right direction. Follow her instructions. She's an advanced Automata and her advice should be heeded.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I like Mr Galosh. He seems like a clever fellow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like Mr Galosh. He seems like a clever fellow.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava, do we need to do what he says?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava, do we need to do what he says?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ava, do we need to do what he says?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ava, do we need to do what he says?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If we want to explore the city, yes. Clearly Thaddeus has some kind of plan for us. This tourist visa requires work, but it will be worthwhile. Let's focus on understanding our journal tasks, and look out for new vendors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If we want to explore the city, yes. Clearly Thaddeus has some kind of plan for us. This tourist visa requires work, but it will be worthwhile. Let's focus on understanding our journal tasks, and look out for new vendors.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But I didn't agree to this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I didn't agree to this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But I didn't agree to this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But I didn't agree to this.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: There's an entry in your Comm for "achievements". That's the module for the Nivalis tourist board. You can follow those. The more you check off that list, the more you'll open up the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's an entry in your Comm for "achievements". That's the module for the Nivalis tourist board. You can follow those. The more you check off that list, the more you'll open up the city.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I thought you were a hacker?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought you were a hacker?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I thought you were a hacker?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I thought you were a hacker?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Fine, I CAN do it. Ten million Lims. You got that much on you today?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine, I CAN do it. Ten million Lims. You got that much on you today?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Right. Meanwhile, I have work to do. When you find your feet, come back to me and I might have more advice on how to unlock new areas. For now, I have other clients who need my time. Tik tok. Time is money for a hacker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. Meanwhile, I have work to do. When you find your feet, come back to me and I might have more advice on how to unlock new areas. For now, I have other clients who need my time. Tik tok. Time is money for a hacker.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess I'll have a look at these tourist achievements then...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess I'll have a look at these tourist achievements then...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess I'll have a look at these tourist achievements then...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess I'll have a look at these tourist achievements then...

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: The purpose of the tourist access visa was to make visitors explore the city to stimulate the local economy. The more activities you take part in, the more city access you'll get.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The purpose of the tourist access visa was to make visitors explore the city to stimulate the local economy. The more activities you take part in, the more city access you'll get.
